theorems.name: Submission.dpf_smooth_approx_compact_perturbation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (K' : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K' ∧ K' ⊆ U ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ψ k)) ∧ (∀ k x, x ∉ K' → ψ k x = x) ∧ (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => ψ k x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x))) ∧ ∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ φ x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
